existing_systems: The existing Starwell MCP bridge and OAuth peer already expose authenticated MCP routes.
root_problem: The current task must use the existing authenticated bridge rather than invent another adapter.
reuse_decision: Extend the existing bridge, reusing its identity, transport, tool catalogue and persistence.
integration_impact: Review Starwell routes, OAuth scopes, Wayglass kernel, crew workspaces and Return Engine receipts.
complete_operation: Implement the full feature, tests and integration verification in a coherent change set.
verification_plan: Run relevant Node tests and exercise authenticated success, denial and revocation against a test host.
return_continuity: Keep attributable author, stop receipt, provenance, and next owner across service restart.
remaining_boundaries: Production deployment, live provider routes and ChatGPT registration remain unverified until receipts exist.
withness_wholeness: The change improves existing connected architecture and avoids a competing second MCP bridge.
